conflicts.permit: We share your personal information with these third party service providers in order to receive their services.
conflicts.prohibit: We will destroy personal information when 1) requested by you and/or 2) that is past its retention period using the methods that prevent recovery of such information.
conflicts.situation: A user requests erasure of personal information that Line Games has retained following account closure to comply with legal obligations.
conflicts.reason: Section 7.5 states personal information may be retained after closure for legal obligations, yet Section 7.5(B) unconditionally states personal information will be destroyed when requested.
